tasks.title: Single command lifecycle + real Mission Control state
tasks.why: Owner must click Generate, Lab Review, type repo path, Run, PR by hand; Running seats/Active tasks/Bottleneck are hard-coded local counters. This is the stated product gap and P1 first bullet.
tasks.spec: New mission resource in services/api/main.py (+ new module services/api/evoforge/missions.py, may extend services/api/evoforge/commands.py): POST /v1/missions {goal, repo_ref, target_paths?, risk} -> 201 {mission_id, state=CREATED, evidence_id}; POST /v1/missions/{id}/advance {to: GENERATED|REVIEWED|RAN|PR_OPENED|CANCELLED|FAILED} executed server-side by calling existing generate->review->runs->pr/create chain with same auth/validation/gate rules, or POST /v1/missions/{id}/cancel -> 200 {state=CANCELLED} from any non-terminal state; terminal states PR_OPENED/CANCELLED/FAILED reject further advance with 409; unknown id 404; HIGH/CRITICAL risk still requires confirm=true else 409. GET /v1/missions lists {mission_id, state, goal, updated_at, evidence_ids} and GET /v1/missions/{id} returns full stage pointers; GET /v1/dashboard returns {missions_by_state, active_missions, blocked_merges, spent_cents, reserved_cents, unknown_holds} computed only from server commands/missions store + GET /v1/ledger snapshot, no client counters. Web: Mission Control (apps/web/app/page.tsx + apps/web/lib/api.ts) gets one objective input + Run mission button polling GET /v1/missions/{id} with visible state chip and Stop/Cancel button; cards render only GET /v1/dashboard; remove local runs+1 and localStorage candidate handoff as state source. Invariants: one mission_id maps to one generate/review/run/PR evidence chain; cancel never deletes evidence; sealed code never in HTTP; proxy allowlist covers new paths with '..'/prefix bypass tests.
acceptance: TestClient real HTTP (no provider mocks except MODEL_API_KEY-absent stub path): create->advance through GENERATED->REVIEWED->RAN->PR_OPENED with stub-blocked run still transitions correctly or 409 with reason; cancel from REVIEWED blocks later advance with 409
GET /v1/dashboard after 2 missions + ledger snapshot matches server counts; Mission Control renders dashboard values, no hard-coded Running seats/Active tasks strings
Auth parity: no session 401, wrong-aud 403 on new endpoints; proxy rejects '..' and non-allowlisted prefix; no token in argv/logs; pytest services/api -q and validate_package.py pass
out_of_scope: evoforge/postgres_*.py, evoforge/evidence.py, kernel_api.py (Codex-owned, link from main.py only)
PostgreSQL persistence of missions (memory store + P0-2 min=max=1 stays)
Changing quality_gates.json thresholds or sealed-test redaction rules
